data.narrative:
Satellogic is a public-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Emiliano Kargieman and Gerardo Richarte, having raised $262M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 4 same-sector, same-stage public companies: Rocket Lab ($40.0B), Planet Labs ($7.6B), Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B), and Astroscale ($840M).

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. The median valuation across these four comps is $5.2B, with a range spanning $840M at the low end (Astroscale) to $40.0B at the high end (Rocket Lab). This wide dispersion reflects material differences in operational scale and market position within the public space technology sector. A revenue-based multiple approach using the Space & Aerospace public median P/S of 27.4x across six tickers could not be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue figures for the target.

The single-method analysis supports a triangulated range of $4.4B (low) to $6.0B (high), with a median estimate of $5.2B. Key uncertainties include the appropriate positioning of Satellogic within this peer band—whether it aligns closer to lower-revenue operators like Astroscale or mid-scale players like Planet Labs—and the applicability of public multiples to a recently public entity. The wide variance among comps ($840M to $40.0B) underscores sector-specific execution and addressable market risks that materially affect valuation.
